_evidence: Bounds for the R3 date/selector wrappers that index the text table: [0x7c2f28] = current driver slot 0x16..0x2b as the 0x528c98/0x528cc5/0x528dd4 callers expect (id = [0x7c2f28]+0xb90 lands in 0xba6..0xbbb); date bytes [0x81d36c] day 0..31, [0x81d36d] month 1..12, [0x81d36e] {0xff,0xff,0,1}.
